head: working-tree
subject: gRPC xDS client status discovery (CSDS)
change: grpc.xds.csds encodes envoy.service.status.v3.ClientStatusResponse without generated protobuf code, and Controller.encodeClientStatus gathers this client's accepted LDS/RDS/CDS/EDS/SDS resources with type URL, name, accepted version, raw wire bytes and status. SotW reports the type's accepted version; delta reports the per-resource accepted version. Subscribed but undelivered resources are included without wire bytes as REQUESTED or DOES_NOT_EXIST, so a dump taken right after start shows what the client is waiting for. The application serves FetchClientStatus from its own gRPC server and returns these bytes; netz does not own an admin listener.

tests.unit: src/grpc/xds/csds.zig covers response encoding for an accepted resource with wire bytes and a does-not-exist resource without wire. src/grpc/xds/csds_tests.zig drives a delta controller through LDS, RDS, CDS and EDS and checks all four accepted entries with their per-resource version and ACKED status, then drives a SotW controller and checks the accepted listener version plus the pending CDS subscription reported as REQUESTED without a version.

notes: The request's node matchers are ignored because the response describes the local client. Resource status maps requested to REQUESTED, does_not_exist to DOES_NOT_EXIST, a transient timeout to REQUESTED, and a delivered resource to ACKED. The encoder emits proto3 defaults by omission and encodes each accepted resource as a google.protobuf.Any with the resource type URL.
